events.title: Update: you can now pet your cat!
events.summary: Hover the cursor over your cat so it stops, then move the mouse left and right as if you were stroking it. No clicking needed. When the cursor turns into a hand, your cat is ready to be petted.Your cat will purr, rub against you, and hearts will float up above it. Petting raises Love (the bar with the heart).Keep in mind that your cat's patience has limits. If you pet it too often, it will let you know that's enough for now and wander off to do its own thing.
